name: Default
shortDescription: Web interface for the motion daemon: video surveillance with motion detection, recording and snapshots from network cameras.

alerts.message: The first login is the user admin with an empty password. Set passwords for the admin and surveillance users right after the first login.
This template has no access to host devices, so only network cameras (RTSP, HTTP/MJPEG or another motionEye server) can be added, not USB or CSI cameras.
